content: Kwardu lav Yazhigǝl kǝ Yukhan dadak paraud
Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sart, a sawal Yukhan dadak para ud da kwardu lav Yazhigǝl ǝn tǝghal ǝntla khay ya Yakhudi.
Ni, “Pǝlam pǝla ghǝr, wirva tlǝksa Yazhigǝla a khǝrzgan.”
Tsa Yukhan dadake tsǝn kwara Ishay tlayang ad laven tǝghǝr tsin kwarne,

content.text: “Kwinda ud ǝn tlǝkh ǝn tǝghal kwarne,

content: Gabage talǝm Yukhan na a manava dǝ guj tlǝgwam. Nguɗan sambal ǝn tǝ khukw tsin. Dǝg zuwa sara tsǝvakwa zǝ mam tǝghal.
Tǝkǝna udakh ya Wurshalim zǝ ǝntla Yakhudi daghan, zǝ daghan ǝntla khay zagh Urdun, ka sakhgawal itar da vaksar,
ka kwarakh khaipakhtar itar, ka paratǝra para tsin ǝn zagh Urdun.
Ai vazga kǝ Yukhan ad Farisakh zǝ Sadukiyakh zikǝn sǝgawal da vaksar kǝ paratǝrapar, ka niya tsitar, “Kur zar ya pushakh. War kǝ khiɗakurf kǝ ngikh kuba rǝvakhuɗ Yazhigǝl nǝn saksi?
Manam giɗe da ǝmdla kwarne a palga kur ghǝr ǝn khaipakhur.
Dzamam ba ǝn khuɗur kwarne, ‘Dadǝnda Brakhim bi,’ Ən tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ. Tǝkha Yazhigǝl kǝ vǝrɗarkhai zara kǝ Brakhim sǝgawal ǝn kurakhan.
Audzalud ǝn bars khil kǝ mbǝrt uf. Itsera kǝ ufe kwal yig zar charan ka ǝntlarsud kǝɗaghud da kar.

“Ni ka ǝn para kura dǝ yu kǝ, kǝ mǝtlada kwarne a palga kur ghǝr, ude ndanga tǝghǝr tsǝka da saks ǝn tǝ khal tsǝk, ude itsa kimbak sar tǝkh ba ka kǝ ɓanǝf bi. In da para kuran dǝ Sǝɗikw Chuwaɗaɗan, zǝ kar tsugun.
Khutan ad kwat kava sar, kǝ kav khi sar ǝn tǝ ghwuzay, ka dzanǝf ad khi, ɗidagh ǝn kuvur sar, ka ndǝghanan ad tlitl dǝ kare kwal tǝkha tsud kǝ kǝɗgan.”
Ən tǝ khalak yan ka sagha Yasu ǝn Galili, da vak Yukhan kǝ parapara tsud ǝn zagha Urdun.
Tsǝn na Yukhan ad gadlara gadl. Ka niya tsin, “Ka tsǝn nagha paraka para tsǝkha ka kha kǝ sagha da vakara?”
Ka ngawarkhai Yasu kwarne, “nalnǝgin ndǝk yan, wirva ndǝk yan khwaran kǝ righada dǝge ǝn nagha Yazhigǝl.” Khal kǝ yana ka khayanǝf Yukhan.
Ən tǝ khal kǝ Parandal tsud Yasu, madvin ǝn sǝgawal ǝn yu, tǝvin tǝvina ka ngurǝf garazhigǝl, ka nǝghan ad sǝɗikw Yazhigǝl ǝn sǝgadagh ndǝk kakur, sodagh da tǝghǝr tsin.
Ka tsǝnud lava sǝgadagh ǝn gharazhigǝl kwarne, “Ina zǝrare ǝn waya kǝ, ǝn tsǝn zǝɗa sar ka char.”
